name: Manage Agents (CRUD)
summary: Create, update, delete agents. Assign to projects. Check agent status.

steps.note: Get current agent list and IDs.
create_agent(display_name, specialization, role, primary_color). update_agent_field(agent_id, field_path, new_value) for any field. delete_agent(agent_id) is permanent.
assign_agent(agent_id, project_name) to link agent to a project.

notes: Deleting an agent frees it from all projects automatically
